question: Which of the following movements is also known as the 'Ulgulan' or the 'Great Tumult' movement?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Munda uprising**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Munda uprising**, also known as **'Ulgulan' or the 'Great Tumult'**, was a significant tribal rebellion led by **Birsa Munda** in the late 19th century.
 
• This movement was primarily against the exploitative practices of the **British colonial administration** and the **landlord system** that oppressed the tribal communities.
 
• The Munda uprising occurred in the region of **Chotanagpur plateau**, which is located in present-day Jharkhand</stro
